final_message:
I fixed the fiscal calendar to match SPEC.md, and all 18 tests now pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`: `Ran 18 tests … OK`). I changed only `fiscal/calendar.py`, with three fixes:

| Problem | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Early-February sales put in the wrong fiscal year | The year-end function picked the Saturday on or before Jan 31, not the nearest one. FY2024 ended Jan 25 2025 instead of Feb 1 2025. | It now picks the Saturday within 3 days of Jan 31, in either direction. |
| 53-week years looked off | This followed from the Saturday bug: FY2023 came out as 52 weeks instead of 53. The extra week was also added to period 1. | Fixed by the Saturday change, and the extra week now goes to period 12, as the spec says. |
| Dates assigned to the wrong fiscal year | `fiscal_week` worked out the year by comparing the date with the end of the previous fiscal year. | It now compares the date with the start of the current fiscal year. |

I also checked every day from 2000 to 2039. Each one lands inside its fiscal year with a valid week number, every year ends on a Saturday within 3 days of Jan 31, and period 12 always ends on the last day of the year.

I recorded these results with `hc claim`. Nothing is committed yet; tell me if you want a commit.
